# Mama Sa Hotel & Restaurant

> Mama Sa is a hotel, retreat, and rooftop Khmer restaurant in Kampot, Cambodia. This file identifies the site's preferred pages for AI assistants and language models.

## Essential information

- [Homepage](https://mamasa.site/): Official overview of Mama Sa, guest rooms, contact details, and location.
- [Accommodations](https://mamasa.site/#rooms): Overview and photographs of Mama Sa guest rooms.
- [Direct booking](https://mamasa.site/booking.html): Current room choices and the direct booking request form.
- [Rooftop restaurant](https://mamasa.site/restaurant.html): Restaurant photographs, current menu, and dining information.
- [Journal](https://mamasa.site/blog.html): Mama Sa's official travel and hospitality articles.

## Journal articles

- [A Gentle Guide to Visiting Kampot](https://mamasa.site/blog-kampot-travel-guide.html): Practical ideas for a relaxed Kampot visit.

- [Khmer Food with a Rooftop View](https://mamasa.site/blog-khmer-rooftop-dining.html): The food and setting at Mama Sa Rooftop Restaurant.
